owner_intro: Enter the code shown when Cleared started, then choose a name and a password.
owner_error_code_wrong: This is not the code Cleared printed. Check the output of the command that started it.
owner_error_code_expired: This code is more than 24 hours old. Restart Cleared to get a new one.
owner_error_name: A name is 1 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or a digit.
owner_error_service_account: This is the name of the machine account Cleared runs as. Pick another one.
owner_error_throttled: Too many tries. Wait {minutes} min, then try again.
owner_error_owner_exists: The owner's account already exists. Sign in instead.
owner_error_other: The account could not be created. Reload the page and try again.
owner_signing_body: Cleared keeps a signature for your approvals on this machine, and has nothing to add to your repository.
owner_signing_more: For a release lock set up by hand
owner_signing_by_hand: A release lock set up by hand reads the public half from the [tracker] section of .cleared/agents.conf, as this line.
owner_signing_existed: A signature already existed on this machine: Cleared kept it.
owner_signing_missing: Cleared could not create its approval signature. Its log says why; npm run setup in v2/ creates it.
owner_detail_code: The code works once, for 24 hours. A name has 1 to 32 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
